title: Tom and the Red Ball
text:
Tom has a red ball. He plays with it in the park every day. One day, the ball falls into the river. Tom is very sad.

A dog swims to the river and brings the ball back. Tom says thank you to the dog. The dog wags its tail. Tom takes the ball home and smiles.

questions.text: What brings the ball back to Tom?
How does Tom probably feel at the end of the story?
Why does Tom smile at the end?

vocabulary.definition: a round object that children throw, kick or catch
a public place with grass and trees where people play
a large natural stream of water that flows into the sea or a lake
shows happiness by raising the corners of the mouth

paragraph_translations: Tom tem uma bola vermelha. Ele brinca com ela no parque todos os dias. Um dia, a bola cai no rio. Tom está muito triste.
Um cachorro nada até o rio e traz a bola de volta. Tom agradece ao cachorro. O cachorro balança o rabo. Tom leva a bola para casa e sorri.
